_help: Machine dependencies of the workflow. .claude/hooks/setup_check.cjs checks them at session start once per machine and records the result in .claude/.state/machine-setup.json (git-ignored). Editing this file makes every machine check again. Install commands run only after the user's yes (Design_System_Intake_Skill/steps/machine-setup.md). Node.js is the one thing a user installs before anything else: the hooks themselves run on it.

dependencies.name: Python 3
dependencies.why: scripts in tools/ (tokens, recolor, project status, Storybook sync, Figma tools check)

install.win32: winget install -e --id Python.Python.3.12 --scope user --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements --override "/quiet InstallAllUsers=0 PrependPath=1 Include_launcher=1"
install.manual: https://www.python.org/downloads/ (Windows: tick Add python.exe to PATH)

dependencies.note_win32: If `python` still opens the Microsoft Store after the install, turn off python.exe and python3.exe in Settings > Apps > Advanced app settings > App execution aliases.

dependencies.name: Git
dependencies.why: handoff check (git log), project repos; on Windows it also gives Claude Code its Bash shell

dependencies.name: Figma Desktop
dependencies.why: every Figma tool (the web app is not enough)
